title: refactor(Development/AutomorphicArithmetic/AutomorphicVarieties/ModularityArgument/GammaLaurentFactors): derive sideG from sideX in CrossG
body:
Derives `UpperTheory.V.Z.Gam.sideG` directly from `UpperTheory.V.Z.ImaginaryQuadraticEtaCharacter.sideX` (`EulerdShift.lean`) and `polFacts` (`PolFacts.lean`), eliminating the four duplicated clump members (`GamLocOf`, `SideGCenOf`, `SideGOf`, `SuppBridge`) in `CrossG.lean`.

Declarations changed:
- Removed unused `UpperTheory.V.Z.Gam.gamLocOf`, `UpperTheory.V.Z.Gam.sideGCenOf`, `UpperTheory.V.Z.Gam.sideGOf`, and `UpperTheory.V.Z.Gam.suppBridge` (together with their private helpers) from `CrossG.lean`.
- Reproved `UpperTheory.V.Z.Gam.sideG` in `CrossG.lean` via `UpperTheory.V.Z.ImaginaryQuadraticEtaCharacter.sideX` and `UpperTheory.V.Z.ImaginaryQuadraticEtaCharacter.polFacts`.
